verdict.rationale: Luma is an API platform, so a sandbox or test environment is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence only shows adjacent features: Draft Mode low-resolution renders, free trial credits, and pay-per-use pricing billed as 'ideal for prototyping'. None of these is a documented sandbox environment isolated from production data, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
